I want to like this game, but it doesn't quite work. You are collecting train cars (and levelling them up with duplicates) as you plot your train's way across a frozen wasteland. Periodic drops give you new cars, but you have only a limited inventory for unused cars, and the length of the train increases as your character levels up. So you can't use everything and must cache some of the extra (for a faster next drop.) You lose happiness steadily through environmental effects, and "collect" it from the cards once per cycle. There's a core of a good idea here, but the game doesn't seem to particularly reward you for making good choices or punish you for making poor ones. Maybe there is a challenge here (I did lose before getting bored) but the core mechanisms are a little opaque.. Which cars get passengers and which do not? What is "full"? How do I level up the various additions that are added, like "training" or "improvement"? It's not bad to have some discovery, but there doesn't seem to be an obvious pay-off when I did get these mechanisms working.

My first playthrough I just picked to go with the blue because they seemed simple and strong and beat it easily. If I try to go for the other colours they just don't appear enough and I struggle. Why would I ever choose anything else, other than to get achievements? Also if you're good enough to draw trains and scenery... you're good enough to draw portraits. Awesome little game. Completed it for 100% Achievements and it was super fun. Very well polished, no major bugs, the game feels and looks quite cool in my opinion. It basically has the Snowpiercer movie atmosphere, but game is more interesting. :) I think it could be a real hit if developed further to have either bigger campaign, expanded character roster, new maps, biomes, locations, synergies, cards, etc. Or alternatively it could add a competitive mode, leaderboard, leagues, or multiplayer. (It already plays a lot like auto-chess). Maybe not a direct online one, but a passive leaderboard competition with season and leagues. For inspiration on how to introduce competitive element to the game I would look at Despot's Game: Dystopian Battle Simulator, it has one of the most unique and best implemented competitive aspects without any typical difficulties of online multiplayer. (matchmaking, online playerbase, wait times, etc.)

所有的构筑都需要2蓝启动，2蓝-4蓝 构筑成型就可以找T0红/T1黄/T2绿/T3白 聊聊最难的36天内通关，选老太太开局 尽量找闪光站点走（X2车厢）找4蓝学院和3加速-5加速，前面可以适当的饶下多走点，在核电站28天剩下的路基本能走完，要是直接选最近的路走幸福度绝壁不够会死，所以前面绕路适当发育下。

13小时全成就，遇到不会的可以留言问我喵🐱 以下是总体评价： 三个人物技能差不多没啥特色。Choi老太反倒是个人感觉最顺手的，虽然每次选牌只能二选 一，但额外两节车厢可以出很多搭配，相比之下Joe小姐就很鸡肋：虽然选牌可以四选一，但幸福值掉的很快很容易前期卡组没成型暴毙。Lim先生中规中矩。 凑车厢要么叠颜色要么叠标记。动力车厢（齿轮标记）叠速度很重要，后期跑不过暴风雪很容易暴毙，红绿蓝白褐都有一张，两张就可以凑羁绊，基本每局都可以凑齐。 蓝色车厢（学院）是最轮椅的，两张启动四张成型。启动后稳定给蓝牌不用看发牌员脸色，左脚踩右脚很容易全五级，全五级后象牙塔稳定给幸福度。然而主玩蓝色上限不够，过了44天后三个五级象牙塔也顶不住幸福值哗哗掉。前期也可以辅助其他体系成型，通过卖牌加速刷牌抓需要的牌。 黄色车厢（引擎之子）的狂热也不错，然而四张牌里有一张彩卡(宣传部）很难刷，只凑两个凑不齐四个羁绊没啥用。前期可以用蓝牌带黄牌等着凑齐，狂热叠过200后幸福值加的很可观。 绿色车厢（探险）根据已探索的城市数加幸福值，三张牌的加成一般，导致前期相当垃圾（探索过的城市少加成很低），主玩绿色前期很容易暴毙。用蓝色带绿色可以过，后期快到终点加成还可以。 褐色车厢（兄弟会）玩起来很费劲，要把七张牌都拿齐才能彻底成型，成型后10倍加成很强，然而凑不齐还有debuff扣除幸福值。属于凑齐了强得很然而总是暴毙半道的状态。 白色车厢减回合时间，可以辅助配合蓝色拿牌，优点是比较好凑。彩卡的头等车厢那张也很好玩，放第一个稳定吃后排车厢数收益，至于通信就是图一乐，加成太少纯为了刷成就。

I NEVER write reviews. if you like balatro type games, this a must. Some helpful info since the tutorial is weak. -A shiny node = 2x Cards -EACH trip across the river gives 2xp= 2 jumps on your level to get more cars. -Bigger nodes give higher level cars, later in the rounds normal nodes also give higher level cars. -Stacking is like Battlegrounds/TFT so 2xsingles=Double, 2xDoubles=Triple. 2xTriples=Quad. -Poison only is in certain areas. -Win 2 rounds with each character to unlock the next one.
